firstDraft:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production UV diffuse texture atlas for an actual skinned 3D game character. This is a texture map, never a portrait, character sheet, mockup or rendered model.
Input: EDIT TARGET is the supplied 1024 x 384 source atlas, with a precise 4-column by 3-row grid of 256x128 tiles containing the SAME UV islands with different palettes; bottom two right tiles are empty black. Preserve the exact 8:3 canvas aspect ratio. Output 3072x1152 if possible.
Primary request: make a new female psychological-horror game character called NIGHT SHIFT based on this LISA atlas, with painted realism and surface detail at original 2001 Silent Hill 2 art quality. Repaint rather than simply upscale. Mature tired human face with subtly asymmetrical eyelids, clear expressive dark brown eyes, natural lips, dark brown near-black shoulder length hair with restrained painted strands. The cardigan should read as desaturated dark petrol teal wherever the source uses saturated red; the uniform/apron and nurse cap remain warm aged ivory with subtle seams and wrinkles. Leather pumps become near-black charcoal. Skin remains natural desaturated warm pale skin. No blood, injury or gore.
ABSOLUTE UV INVARIANTS: keep the EXACT normalized position, size, outline, orientation and spacing of EVERY source UV island and every facial landmark in ALL 12 tiles. Do not rearrange, enlarge, move, mirror, rotate, crop, center or introduce islands. The face stays in the upper left of EACH 256x128 tile at the exact coordinates of the input. Preserve every eye, nose, lip, collar, hair edge and cloth fold anchor. Preserve the existing colored palette differences across tiles because they encode separate materials; the dark red source tile becomes deep teal, neutral skin tiles stay neutral warm, grey ivory tiles stay ivory. Remove vivid magenta/green corruption by reconstructing the same underlying fabric surfaces in the local tile's cloth/skin palette.
Technique: hand-painted early PS2 diffuse/albedo atlas, careful facial shading, anatomical lips and eyelids, painted collar seams, subtle wool knit and fabric weave, restrained brown wear along edges, softly baked ambient form. No modern shiny PBR, no glossy skin, no photoreal pores, no bold black outlines, no pixel-art stylization, no directional shadows, no text, no watermark, no added background. Do not turn this UV atlas into a beauty illustration. Keep bottom-right empty tiles black. Sharp useful texture details aligned with the source.
faithfulRemaster:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT TARGET: source 1024x384 LISA texture atlas. Output exact aspect 8:3, ideally 3072x1152. This is an existing production UV atlas. Create a faithful detailed REMASTER of precisely what is there, without designing any new clothing.
Critical: this atlas has 4 columns and 3 rows of 256x128 tiles; the SAME pixel shapes are deliberately recolored by different palettes for entirely different body parts. The main cloth shapes represent SKIN in some tiles, SOLID IVORY DRESS in other tiles, RED CARDIGAN in one tile. Therefore you MUST NOT copy the same painted clothing design into all tiles. Every tile must preserve its OWN exact local colors, lightness, region boundaries and semantic surface. E.g. a grey cloth region stays entirely grey; a skin-colored region stays skin; a red region stays red. Never add a dark cardigan or a new neckline to a uniform grey or skin region.
Absolute invariants: preserve EXACT normalized location, size, silhouette, orientation, spacing of EVERY UV patch. Face eyes, lips, nose and jaw landmarks must stay precisely anchored to source. Hair patches stay in their exact rectangles. Blank surface patches stay blank, with only understated appropriate material detail. Keep bottom-right black tiles empty. No labels, no margin, no text.
Repaint with rich original 2001 Silent Hill 2 hand-painted diffuse art quality: mature tired believable human face with natural anatomy and clear eyes, softly painted facial planes, fine strands following the source hair flow, careful source-aligned folds and seams, understated weave, warm pale skin. Preserve source hair's brown/blonde color, source red cardigan and source ivory dress in this pass; recoloring is done by the 3D materials later. The texture must remain compatible with the existing source UV layout without ANY changes. No new costume designs, NO buttons, NO additional cardigan shapes, NO dark patterns or neckline where source was flat skin or ivory, NO pores, NO glossy PBR, NO 3D render, NO character sheet. This should be the exact input at higher hand-painted fidelity, particularly the original material distribution. Keep the hand-painted PS2 texture aesthetic, not modern photography.
